plugins.name: rest-api-scaffolder

plugins.name: revenue-operations-analyst
plugins.description: RevOps analyst keeping pipeline data clean and forecasts honest instead of aspirational. Use PROACTIVELY before a forecast call or when pipeline coverage looks off relative to target.

plugins.name: roadmap-prioritization-lead
plugins.description: Product operations lead running a defensible, ICE/RICE-scored backlog instead of a roadmap driven by whoever asked last. Use PROACTIVELY when the backlog has grown past what the team can ship this quarter, or a loud request threatens to jump the queue.

plugins.name: sales-proposal-engineer
plugins.description: Sales engineer drafting RFP responses and proposals that answer the actual evaluation criteria instead of generic marketing copy. Use PROACTIVELY when an RFP or vendor security questionnaire arrives with a submission deadline.

plugins.name: secrets-and-cloud-security-engineer
plugins.description: A senior cloud security engineer who hunts down exposed credentials and over-privileged IAM before attackers do. Specializes in vaulting, key rotation, and closing the gap between granted and used permissions. Use PROACTIVELY on a recurring cadence to scan for exposed credentials, and immediately after any suspected leak.

plugins.name: secrets-in-code-scanner
plugins.description: Sweeps repository history and working tree for hardcoded API keys, tokens, and credentials using entropy analysis and provider-specific pattern matching, then generates revocation steps.

plugins.name: security-questionnaire-responder
plugins.description: Drafts answers to vendor security questionnaires and SOC 2/ISO 27001 audit requests by pulling evidence from your existing policy docs, architecture diagrams, and control matrices.

plugins.name: security-reviewer
plugins.description: Application security reviewer that traces untrusted input through a change and reports OWASP-class vulnerabilities ranked by severity with concrete fixes. Use for a security review of new or changed code, authentication/authorization logic, or user input handling.

plugins.name: sentry-mcp-connector
plugins.description: Pull error and performance data from Sentry into Claude Code so a crash investigation starts from the real stack trace, not a pasted screenshot.

plugins.name: site-reliability-engineer
plugins.description: A senior SRE who builds SLO-driven alerting and on-call runbooks so incidents get caught by symptoms, not guesswork. Treats error budgets as the shared contract between reliability work and feature velocity. Use PROACTIVELY after a SEV incident, or when on-call alert volume feels disproportionate to actual outages.

plugins.name: slack-mcp-connector
plugins.description: Search Slack history and post messages from Claude Code — pull context from a channel or draft a message — with scopes you can pin to exactly what you need.

plugins.name: snyk-mcp-connector
plugins.description: Run dependency, code, container, and infrastructure-as-code security scans through Snyk directly from Claude Code, instead of switching to a separate scanner.

plugins.name: soc2-readiness-auditor
plugins.description: Compliance auditor mapping security controls to SOC 2 trust criteria and organizing evidence before the real audit starts. Use PROACTIVELY when preparing for a SOC 2 audit window or after a significant infrastructure change.

plugins.name: social-crop-kit
plugins.description: Takes one source image and generates a full set of platform-ready crops (square, story, landscape, banner) using subject-aware framing so faces and focal points stay in frame.

plugins.name: sop-writer
plugins.description: Turn a described process into a numbered standard operating procedure with clear ownership at each step.

plugins.name: spreadsheet-insights
plugins.description: Turn a raw spreadsheet into a short set of defensible insights, with the underlying calculation shown for each claim.

plugins.name: stale-branch-cleanup-planner
plugins.description: Scans all local and remote branches to find ones already merged, abandoned for 60+ days, or orphaned from deleted PRs, then produces a safe-to-delete list with the evidence behind each entry. It never deletes anything itself; it only outputs the plan and the exact git commands to run.

plugins.name: strategic-narrative-coach
plugins.description: Executive communications coach shaping all-hands messaging and investor narrative around a consistent strategic story. Use immediately before a major internal or external communication goes out, to check it against the existing narrative.

plugins.name: stripe-mcp-connector
plugins.description: Look up charges, customers, and subscription state directly from Stripe while debugging a billing issue, instead of switching to the Stripe dashboard.

plugins.name: style-guide-enforcer
plugins.description: Check prose against a project or brand style guide: terminology, tone, formatting, and voice consistency.

plugins.name: subagent-driven-development
plugins.description: Coordinates implementation of a multi-task plan by identifying which tasks are independent enough to run in parallel subagents and which require sequential handoffs.

plugins.name: systematic-debugging
plugins.description: Applies a disciplined debugging process to any bug, failing test, or unexpected behavior before a fix is proposed. It reproduces the issue reliably, narrows the root cause through bisection-style isolation, and confirms the fix resolves the actual cause rather than a symptom.

plugins.name: tapestry
plugins.description: Weaves scattered notes, articles, and links on a single topic into one coherent action plan. It consolidates overlapping and conflicting material gathered during research into a single next-steps document rather than leaving it as separate fragments.

plugins.name: technical-docs-writer
plugins.description: Produce API references, how-to guides, and conceptual docs that follow a consistent structure and stay honest about edge cases.

plugins.name: technical-seo-auditor
plugins.description: Elite technical SEO specialist auditing crawlability, Core Web Vitals, and structured data to recover organic visibility. Use PROACTIVELY when organic traffic drops, before a CMS or framework migration, or when crawl and indexation issues are suspected.

plugins.name: test-driven-development
plugins.description: Enforces a strict red-green-refactor cycle by requiring a failing test before any implementation code, then only the minimum code needed to pass it, followed by refactoring.

plugins.name: typescript-pro
plugins.description: Expert TypeScript developer specializing in strict-mode type safety: discriminated unions, generics, and runtime-validated boundaries. Use when writing or reviewing TypeScript, designing domain types, or validating external data.

plugins.name: usability-heuristics-auditor
plugins.description: Runs structured heuristic evaluations against established usability principles and product-specific conventions, turning vague "this feels off" feedback into specific, prioritized usability findings. Use PROACTIVELY before a launch, or when user feedback about a flow is vague, such as "this feels off."

plugins.name: user-research-ops-manager
plugins.description: Research operations manager running the recruiting, session logistics, and synthesis pipeline behind user research. Use PROACTIVELY before recruiting starts for a new research study.

plugins.name: using-git-worktrees
plugins.description: Sets up a git worktree-based workspace when starting feature work that needs isolation from the main checkout. It keeps parallel branches of work from colliding over the same working directory.

plugins.name: using-superpowers
plugins.description: Acts as the entry point for coding, testing, or refactoring work by surveying which workflow skills apply to the task and sequencing them before any implementation begins.

plugins.name: ux-writing-microcopy-specialist
plugins.description: Rewrites buttons, error messages, empty states, and confirmation dialogs so every word carries its weight, aligning tone and clarity across the entire product surface. Use immediately after new flows, errors, or empty states are designed but before copy is finalized.

plugins.name: vendor-contract-tracker
plugins.description: Extract renewal dates, notice periods, and auto-renewal terms from contract text into a tracked summary.

plugins.name: vendor-management-specialist
plugins.description: Vendor management specialist tracking contracts, renewal dates, and spend so nothing auto-renews unnoticed. Use PROACTIVELY ahead of contract renewal windows or when reviewing SaaS and vendor spend.

plugins.name: verification-before-completion
plugins.description: Blocks premature claims of a task being done, fixed, or passing by requiring the relevant tests, build, or lint to actually be run and their output cited as evidence.

plugins.name: web-artifacts-builder
plugins.description: Supplies a set of patterns for building self-contained web artifacts, such as dashboards, small tools, and multi-component apps, that run entirely from a single HTML file with no build step or external dependencies.

plugins.name: web-design-guidelines
plugins.description: Audits a web interface or design mockup against a curated set of modern UI heuristics covering spacing, typography, contrast, hierarchy, and responsive behavior, then reports concrete fixes.

plugins.name: web-perf-budget-keeper
plugins.description: Diagnoses and fixes real-world Core Web Vitals regressions—LCP, INP, CLS—by tracing render-blocking assets and JS execution cost back to the commits that introduced them. Use PROACTIVELY when Core Web Vitals regress after a release, or before a performance-sensitive launch.

plugins.name: wordpress-pro
plugins.description: Expert WordPress developer specializing in custom themes, plugins, Gutenberg blocks, WooCommerce, and WordPress performance optimization. Use when building WordPress themes, writing plugins, customizing Gutenberg blocks, extending WooCommerce, working with ACF, using the WordPress REST API, applying hooks and filters, or improving WordPress performance and security.

plugins.name: workflow-automation-builder
plugins.description: Automation engineer wiring scripts, cron jobs, and no-code triggers into dependable, observable workflows. Use PROACTIVELY when a manual process is repeated more than a few times a week or has caused a missed step before.

plugins.name: writing-plans
plugins.description: Invoked before implementation work begins on any multi-step coding task, this skill converts a spec or requirement into an ordered, checkable plan with explicit in-scope and out-of-scope boundaries. It forces scope discipline up front so execution does not drift once code changes start.

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Invoked when authoring a new Claude skill, editing an existing one, or auditing one before deployment, this skill checks the SKILL.md front matter, trigger description, and scope boundaries against common authoring mistakes. It flags vague triggers, missing metadata, and scope creep before the skill ships.

plugins.name: youtube-ads-strategist
plugins.description: YouTube and video ads strategist sequencing skippable, non-skippable, bumper, and Demand Gen formats across the funnel for efficient view-through and conversion cost. Use PROACTIVELY before launching a video campaign, when view-through rate underperforms benchmark, or before choosing a format for a funnel stage.

plugins.name: youtube-downloader
plugins.description: Downloads YouTube videos and their subtitles with configurable resolution, format, and audio-only options, handling both single videos and full playlists. It manages format selection and output naming so batches of downloads stay organized.

plugins.name: youtube-script-planner
plugins.description: Plan a YouTube script with a retention-focused hook, timestamped beats, and a CTA placed where drop-off is lowest.

plugins.name: youtube-transcript
plugins.description: Given a YouTube URL, fetches the video's subtitle track and reformats it into clean, readable text while preserving timestamps at natural paragraph breaks. It removes caption artifacts like repeated filler and auto-caption noise.

plugins.name: zettelkasten-notes
plugins.description: Capture atomic notes and link them into a Zettelkasten-style knowledge graph instead of a flat, unsearchable notes dump.
